items.title: بيان من كوبر للاستثمار التجارى و التطوير العقارى (COPR.CA) بخصوص نموذج الإفصاح
items.title_en: Statement from Cooper for Commercial Investment and Real Estate Development (COPR.CA) regarding the disclosure form
items.meaning: A statement to the exchange that does not fall into one of the standard categories. What it says is in the filing.
